name: Wakaki Veruta no Bousou
original_name: 若きヴェルターの暴走
source:
Kenzo yearns for Misaki, but she's engaged to his elder brother.
She'll become his sister in law. It's so unbearable he could commit suicide.
Will he let the wedding proceed? No! He'll make Misaki his own...! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE083123.html]DLsite[/url]]
